fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunging kick at a target up to 5 tiles away that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Noon Heat Snort
fusions.desc: You snort stored sun-heat in a cone up to 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sun on the Flanks
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Warmed by Noon
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
